text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[On Play] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Numemon] in its name from your trash as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, gain 2 memory.
[On Play][When Digivolving] on] 1 of your opponent’s Digimon gets -3000 DP and gains ＜Security Attack -1＞ until the end of their turn.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Monzaemon] or [Numemon] in its name, it gains ＜Security Attack +1＞.
